paite: Huan Israel ta masapen Reuben tapate (amah piang masapen ahi a; himahleh apa lupna ahihbuah ziak in, piandan a u-pa hihna Israel tapa, Joseph tapate kiang a piak ahi; huchi in upatna dungzui in khangthu akisim kei hi.
heading: Reuben Suante

paite: A-unaute tung ah Judah avualzou a, amah a kipan in vaihawmtu ahong om a; himahleh upatna Joseph a ahi).
Israel ta masapen Reuben tapate: Hanok, Pallu, Hezron, leh Karmi.
Joel tapate: atapa Shemaiah, atapa Gog, atapa Shimei,
atapa Mikah, atapa Reaiah, atapa Baal;
atapa Beerah, atapa Assuria, kumpipa Tilgath-pilneser in apimang; amah Reuben mite vaihawmtu ahi.
Huan akhangthute uh khangthu sutna akisim lai a a-inkuankuan ua a-unaute; hausa makaipa, Jeiel leh Zekariah,
Azaz tapa Bela, Joel tapa Shema, Aroer a teng, Nebo leh Baal-meon pha a teng.
Suahlam ah luipi Euphrates a kipan gamdai lutna pha in atengta hi; Gilead gam a agante uh apun ziak in.
Huan Saul dam lai in Hagri mite toh akidou ua, huaite azou a: Gilead suahlam gam tengteng ah apuaninte uah ateng uhi.
Huan Gad tapate amau zawntak ah, Salkah tan in Bashan gam ah ateng uh:
heading: Gad Suante

paite: Hausa makai Joel leh azom Shapham, Janai leh Bashan ah Shaphat:
Apipute uh inkote a-unaute uh: Mikael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jakan, Zia leh Eber, sagih ahi uh.
Hiaite Huri tapa Abihail tapate ahi uh, Jaroah tapa, Gilead tapa, Mikael tapa. Jeshishai tapa. Jahdo tapa, Buz tapa;
Abdiel tapa Ahi, Guni tapa, apipute uh inkote hausapa.
Bashan a Gilead ah, akhopite, Sharon huapkhakte tengteng, agamgi tanpha ah ateng uhi.
Hiaite tengteng Judah Kumpipa Jotham dam lai leh Israel kumpipa Jeroboam dam lai in akhangthute in sim in a-om vek uhi.
Reuben tapate leh Gad mite leh Manasseh nam kimkhat mihangsante, namsau leh lum thuah thei mite leh thalpeu a kap ding, kidou siam, galkap dia kuan thei, singli sangli zasagih-le-sawmguk ahi uh.
heading: Suahlam Namte Sepaihte

paite: Hagarit mite, Jetur toh, Naphish toh, Nodab toh akidou uhi.

Amaute dou ding in panpih in a-om ua, huchi in Hagarit mite akhut ua piak in a-om ua, akiang ua om tengteng toh; amau lah Pathian kiang ah kidouna ah akap ngal ua, Pathian in angetna uh aza a; amah a amuanna uh akoih ziak un.
Huchi in agante uh alamang ua; asangawngsau uh singnga, belam nuainih-le-singnga, sabiltung sangnih, mite nuaikhat.
Kidouna Pathian a ahih ziak in, mi tampi petmah apuk uhi. Huchi in saltanna tanpha in amun uah atengta uhi.
Huan Manasseh nam kimkhatte tate gamsung ah ateng ua: Bashan a kipan Baal-hermon leh Senir leh Hermon tang tan in apung uhi.
heading: Suahlam Manasseh Mite

paite: Hiaite Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, Jahdiel, mihat hangsante, miminthangte, apipute uh inkuan a lupente ahi uhi.
Huchi in apipute uh Pathian dou in atalek ua, ama ua Pathian in ahihsiat, gam a mite pathiante lak ah ang akawm uhi.
heading: Suahlam Namte Puakmangna

paite: Israel' Pathian in Assuria kumpipa Pul kha leh Assuria kumpipa Tiglath-pileser kha atokthou a, huchi in amaute apimang a, Reuben mite leh Gad mite leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte mahmah, Halah, Habor, Hara leh Gozan lui pha in api a, tuni tanpha a-om uh.
